details:
1. Have the following hardware: Radeon 6800M GPU, any driver version

2. OpenVR Chat

3. Go to either of the following worlds:

* A. https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_0c3c0636-00db-4e81-87a4-ff0bac24856c/info

* B. https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_59e0a72d-8f4e-4b25-9648-f8b03bb2f882/info

* C. https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_ff414a30-31e3-44bb-9c8e-3d721e895b0b/info

4. Some kind of shader causes the image in the headset to "double" while looking left and right. In the case of A, the world is fine EXCEPT when going into the light specifically. In the case of B, the problem is present in the opening/exterior of the world, but fine once I go inside. I can also replicate the problem by opening up the camera in the interior. In the case of C, it also happens in isolated areas. Also the effect causes massive frame dips, like greater than 50%.

The perfect example of this is in world A where it's repeatable and verifiably happening.

There are other worlds that incorporate some shaders that probably cause this issue that might be related together. 

5. This has been happening or like two or three years.
title: VRChat graphical issues inside of headsets with AMD GPUs (Major frame dips/stuttering issues)
